reply.text:
I'd need to know how many days a week you can actually train. PPL shines at 5 to 6 days, since each muscle gets hit about twice a week. Upper/lower is the better fit at 3 to 4 days, because it gets that same twice-a-week frequency without piling up sessions.

If you're at 4 days or fewer, I'd go upper/lower. It's easier to keep going when life gets busy, and a missed day costs you less. If you've got 5 or 6 days and like the longer-volume feel of dedicated push, pull and legs days, PPL is great.

How many days are you realistically training? Tell me that and I can build it for you.
